correct.description: Dumbbells start at shoulder height with palms facing the body, rotate and press to full overhead lockout with palms facing forward, without excessive lower-back arch

common_errors.description: Arms do not reach full extension overhead -- incomplete lockout
Lower back arches excessively to help drive the press overhead -- a spinal-safety concern
common_errors.status_note: Same injury mechanism as overhead_press.json's lumbar_hyperextension fault (Arnold press is an overhead-press variant) -- not explicitly named in this build task's hard-rule list, but sharing the identical uncertain safety geometry, so treated the same way rather than guessing a threshold for one press variant and not its close relative. No threshold value is seeded pending PT confirmation.

keypoint_signature.rule: PROXY ONLY, not PT-confirmed: angle(shoulder, hip, knee) deviates from a neutral-spine reference by more than threshold.arnold_lumbar_arch_tolerance -- do not implement against this rule without PT sign-off.

reference_keypoints._landmark_limitation_note: "rotation path" (EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §3's key-faults column, the palms-in-to-palms-forward rotation this exercise is named for) is intentionally NOT a common_error here -- the Stage-0 keypoint schema carries landmark POSITION (x/y/z/visibility) only, not wrist/forearm ORIENTATION, so rotation can't be measured without data the pipeline doesn't capture. This is a sensing-capability gap, not a biomechanics question -- flagged for whoever scopes Stage 5b, not silently dropped.

thresholds._status: SEED values only -- placeholders pending real field-measured tuning per EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §4. Not authoritative; do not treat as validated. arnold_lumbar_arch_tolerance is intentionally null -- see the lumbar_arch fault's status_note.

rep_counting._note: "top" = full overhead lockout (rest/reference, highest elbow angle), "bottom" = racked at the shoulder (peak flexion) -- same top=rest/bottom=effort convention as pushup.json/overhead_press.json.

coaching_cues.setup: Dumbbells at shoulders, palms facing you, core braced
coaching_cues.execution: Rotate and press overhead, keep your ribs down
coaching_cues.set_complete_no_flags: Strong set. Clean lockout every rep.
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Good set. Next time, watch your {flag_body_part} — {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.lockout_rom: Press all the way to full lockout
flag_cues.lumbar_arch: Keep your ribs down, brace your core

shoulder_injury.modification: Reduce range of motion or drop the rotation, pressing straight up instead. Stop if you feel shoulder pain.

back_injury.modification: Brace your core hard and avoid arching. Consider a seated variation with back support.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding (Valsalva). Breathe out as you press up.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only. Cannot override rep count or safety flags -- and per this contract's hard rule, cannot substitute for PT confirmation on the lumbar_arch fault's threshold either. Default off until eval passes.
